title: Automated recovery test
summary: Tests dozens of servers in parallel with safety checks and audit evidence.
lead: Testing a recovery plan went from an expensive event to a routine.
problem: Validating that a recovery plan really works took about two hours of manual work. Because testing was expensive, it rarely happened, and an untested plan is just a hypothesis.
idea: Automate the full test: bring servers up in groups in an isolated environment that never touches production, with safety checks, and leave a report as audit evidence.
change: Validation now takes 45 minutes, 62% less, and can be repeated whenever needed. Surprises show up in the test, not during a real outage.
role: I defined the recovery order by server group, wrote the automation on top of Site Recovery, added the checks that prevent touching production and built the report that serves as evidence.
note: I show the what and the why. Code and client data stay inside Readymind.
